sketches.title: I-70/I-135/US-81 Interchange near Salina
sketches.desc: KDOT is proposing large, excessive designs for the I-70/I-135/US-81 interchange just outside of Salina, see links below to their alternatives. I wanted to design a cost-effective, safe alternative that keeps all interstate-to-interstate links as free-flow system ramps. https://www.ksdot.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/14189/638991378260030000 https://www.ksdot.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/14187/638991378719000000
